decision_question: Can a Known Bad be recorded without binding its failure to a mechanism?
hypothesis: A Known Bad is only usable as a discrimination reference when every history event is bound to the mechanism it demonstrates.
uncertainty: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: this record attempts to omit mechanism_reference on one history event.

evidence.statement: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: one history evidence item cites a failure event with no mechanism reference.

decision_rule: Every history_evidence item must carry both evidence_reference and mechanism_reference; a failure that is not bound to a mechanism cannot discriminate.
result: The reference record is rejected because a history evidence item is not bound to its mechanism.
next_action: Bind the recorded failure to the mechanism it demonstrates, or mark the dossier UNRESOLVED.
